name: Sooraj Barjatya
bio:
​From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Sooraj R. Barjatya is an Indian Hindi film director. His films are produced under the Rajshri Productions banner which was first founded in 1947 by his late grandfather Tarachand Barjatya. As a director he is most known for his early hits, Maine Pyar Kiya (1989) and Hum Aapke Hain Kaun (1994).

Description above from the Wikipedia article Sooraj R. Barjatya, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.

credits.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
credits.overview: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

Bhupen had a lifelong dream of going to Mount Everest with his three friends but the idea is quashed immediately as soon as he expresses it to them during a get-together. credits.title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
credits.overview: While recovering from an assassination attempt four days before his coronation, a stern prince is replaced by a romantic lookalike.

credits.title: Vivah
credits.overview: Poonam, a traditionally brought-up young woman, is to marry Prem, a groom chosen by her uncle. Poonam and Prem's faith and love are to be tested however, when an accident occurs and Poonam might be scarred for life.

credits.title: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
credits.overview: Sanjana is a vivacious young woman who lives life on her own terms. She becomes upset when her mother, Susheela, arranges for her to meet a boy as a potential marriage prospect.

credits.title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
credits.overview: A wealthy businessman's traditional family celebrate their togetherness when his three sons get married, but slowly find themselves growing apart after a misunderstanding.

credits.title: Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!
credits.overview: Prem and Nisha meet and fall in love at the wedding of their elder siblings, but their plans to be together are put in jeopardy when Nisha's sister dies, leaving behind a baby.

credits.title: Maine Pyar Kiya
credits.overview: After Suman's father leaves her in the care of another family while he travels abroad, she falls in love with Prem. However, in order to for them to marry, Prem has to prove to Suman's father that he is not the same as his own dad.
